module: Career vehicle marketplace: generates and maintains the list of vehicles for sale (dealerships and private sellers), manages their lifetime, their "sale" while the player is away, the watchlist, opening the shop (from a dealership or the garage computer), vehicle inspection, the purchase screen (fees, 7% taxes, trade-in, discounts, insurance, custom plate) and the delivery or spawning of the purchased vehicle. Sends data to the UI via the guihooks vehicleShoppingData and vehiclePurchaseData. The list is saved in <profile>/career/vehicleShop.json.
notes: Constants: offers valid for 10 min (vehicleOfferTimeToLive), one vehicle generated per seller every 60 s / vehicleGenerationMultiplier, sold vehicle removed 5 min later, delivery 60 s (1 s if under 500 m), tax 0.07, custom plate 300, moduleVersion 61 (list ignored if info.json has a lower version).

Generation: util_configListGenerator.getEligibleVehicles then getRandomVehicleInfos with a normalized population (factor 0.4); avoids configs already for sale at the same seller. Year drawn between the config's bounds, mileage drawn according to filter.whiteList.Mileage, value adjusted by career_modules_valueCalculator, price rounded by seller.priceRoundingType (prestige, private, dealer or 10), negotiation via career_modules_marketplace.generatePersonality. "private" seller: random parking spot (tag notprivatesale excluded). Dealerships with staticInventory: fixed list generated once.

Expired offers are removed, except those in the watchlist which become "sold" (soldFor, soldViewCounter) and stay visible for 5 min; the watchlistVehicleSold toast and the TOO_LATE achievement are triggered in onUpdate when a watched, uninspected vehicle expires.

Purchase types (purchaseType): "inspect" (vehicle already spawned, bought via career_modules_inspectVehicle) and "instant" (direct purchase, spawn in a dealership spot or shipping to the garage with delay if makeDelivery).
Related achievements: GOOD_DEAL / DEAL_MAKER (negotiated price < asking, <= 80%), SERIOUS_PURCHASE (>= 100,000).
Bug: generateShopId is supposed to avoid duplicate identifiers, but the inner loop `break` then `return shopId` always returns the first draw without any real check.

Minor bug: in onComputerAddFunctions, the code block of an old check is commented out; only the tutorial reasons (tutorialPartShoppingActive/tutorialTuningActive) and the "vehicleShopping" permissions disable the button.
The local functions (getRoundedPrice, spawnVehicle, buyVehicleAndSendToGarage, etc.) are not exported.
onExtensionLoaded returns false if the career is not active (the module does not load).

getShoppingData.desc: Builds the shop data for the UI: vehicles for sale and sold, dealerships (with vehicle count, disabled during onboarding except apmStarterVehicles), current and selected seller, player's money and attributes, free inventory slots, purchase rights.

returns.desc: Data sent by the vehicleShoppingData guihook.

sendShoppingDataToUI.desc: Sends getShoppingData to the UI (guihooks vehicleShoppingData).

getVehicleInfoByShopId.desc: Finds a vehicle for sale by its shopId.

getEligibleVehiclesWithoutDealershipVehi.desc: Returns a copy of the list of eligible configs without those already offered by the given seller.

updateVehicleList.desc: Updates the list of vehicles for sale: removes expired offers or those with a missing model, generates each seller's new vehicles according to the elapsed time.

fromScratch.desc: If true, clears everything and regenerates from scratch.

getVisualValueFromMileage.desc: Converts a mileage into a visual wear factor (1 up to 10,000,000, decreasing to 0.75 at 2,000,000,000), passed to partCondition.initConditions on spawn.

mileage.desc: Odometer in game units (meters, inferred from code).

navigateToPos.desc: Draws ground guidance to a position and returns to the game screen ("play").

openShop.desc: Opens the shop: updates the list, computes quick travel distances and prices, creates the tether (4 m sphere in front of a dealership, or the computer's door) and navigates to the shop screen. Emits the onVehicleShoppingMenuOpened({seller}) hook.

screenTag.desc: Screen tag passed to the UI.

endShopping.desc: Closes all career menus and emits the onVehicleShoppingMenuClosed hook. Also called by the tether.

cancelShopping.desc: Returns to the originating computer's menu, or closes all menus.

requestExit.desc: Router back button handler: equivalent to cancelShopping.

requestVehicleListExit.desc: Exit from the vehicle list: with a current seller, cancels the shop; otherwise deselects the seller and returns to the sellers screen.

selectSeller.desc: The UI chose a seller: records it, emits onVehicleShoppingSelectedSellerIdChanged, sends the data and navigates to the vehicle list.

getSelectedSellerBreadcrumbTitle.desc: Title of the selected seller for the UI breadcrumb.

getCurrentSellerId.desc: Returns the id of the current dealership (nil if via the computer).

getVehiclesInShop.desc: Returns the internal table of vehicles for sale.

showVehicle.desc: Starts the inspection of a vehicle for sale (fade, spawn via career_modules_inspectVehicle.startInspection). Emits onVehicleShoppingVehicleShown on success.

quickTravelToVehicle.desc: Like showVehicle, but teleports the player to the vehicle.

openPurchaseMenu.desc: Opens the purchase screen for an offer, adds the offer to the watchlist and emits onVehicleShoppingPurchaseMenuOpened({purchaseType, shopId}).

sendPurchaseDataToUi.desc: Computes the prices (fees, discount, trade-in, 7% taxes, final price), the insurance, the test drive damage fees, then sends vehiclePurchaseData to the UI.

updateInsuranceSelection.desc: Changes the selected insurance for the current purchase and resends the data.

buyFromPurchaseMenu.desc: Executes the purchase from the purchase screen: pays, spawns or delivers the vehicle, removes any trade-in from the inventory, charges the custom plate and removes the offer from the list.

buySpawnedVehicle.desc: Buys the already spawned vehicle from the inspection (pays, adds to the inventory, plate, enters it if the player is driving it).

cancelPurchase.desc: Cancels the purchase: closes the menus for "inspect", reopens the shop for "instant".

requestPurchaseExit.desc: Back from the purchase screen: closes the menus for "inspect", otherwise returns to the vehicle list.

removeTradeInVehicle.desc: Removes the trade-in vehicle from the current purchase and updates the UI.

openInventoryMenuForTradeIn.desc: Opens the inventory menu to choose a vehicle to trade in (repair required, owner required); the value is computed by valueCalculator.

onAddedVehiclePartsToInventory.desc: Inventory hook after the parts of a purchased vehicle are added: records year, original parts and modified slots, deletes the vehicle object if delivery, closes the shop, emits onVehicleAddedToInventory and saves if autosave.

inventoryId.desc: Inventory id of the new vehicle.

onVehicleSpawnFinished.desc: Called by the vehicle (queueGameEngineLua) when its part conditions are initialized: adds it to the inventory, enters it if it is the player vehicle, applies delivery delay and plate.

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Garage computer hook: adds the general function "vehicleShop" (vehicle marketplace), disabled during the tutorial or if permissions deny vehicleShopping.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: loads vehicleShop.json from the save if the version is compatible. Returns false outside an active career.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes vehicleShop.json (offers, sellers, watchlist, static state).

onShoppingMenuClosed.desc: Hook emitted when the shop closes: removes the tether.

onRouteEnter.desc: UI router hook: restores the selected seller from the route parameters (sellerId).

onRouteMount.desc: UI router hook: sends the shop data once the view is mounted.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook (only in "play" UI state): monitors the watchlist and signals by toast the sale of a watched vehicle whose offer has expired.

onUiChangedState.desc: Hook emitted on each UI state change: remembers the current state.
